title: Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi to grace the 115th Foundation Day of National Test House in Bengaluru tomorrow
subtitle:
The Hon’ble Minister will Inaugurate New Testing Facilities, Digital Initiatives, and Strategic Collaborations at the Jakkuru Campus
Multiple new facilities across the NTH network, the NTH Suvidha mobile app, and the new NTH Bengaluru building to be inaugurated during the grand event
body_text:
The National Test House (NTH), Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India, is set to host a grand celebration for its 115th Foundation Day tomorrow, 29 August 2026, at its Jakkuru Campus in Bengaluru. The flagship event will be graced by Shri Pralhad Joshi, Hon’ble Union Minister of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, New & Renewable Energy, and Education as the Chief Guest.
The commemorative programme will also witness the august presence of Shri B. L. Verma, Hon’ble Union Minister of State for Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution and Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, and Sushri Shobha Karandlaje, Hon’ble Union Minister of State for MSME & Labour and Employment, and Smt. Nidhi Khare, Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs. They will be joined by senior government officials, industry representatives, and other distinguished dignitaries to mark this historic milestone in India's quality assurance journey.
A major highlight of the Foundation Day event will be the inauguration of the state-of-the-art NTH Bengaluru building. Furthermore, the Hon'ble Minister will virtually inaugurate several crucial facilities and initiatives across the broader NTH network to expand nationwide testing capabilities and improve accessibility. These include the Coal Testing Facility at Kolkata, the Solar Water Heater Testing Facility at Chennai, the Utensils Testing Facility at Jaipur, and the new NTH Laboratory at Deendayal Hastkala Sankul (Trade Centre), Varanasi. The event will also feature the official launch of the much-anticipated "NTH Suvidha" mobile application, designed to streamline testing access for industry stakeholders and MSMEs.

enrichment.summary: The National Test House (NTH), under the Department of Consumer Affairs, is celebrating its 115th Foundation Day on 29 August 2026 at its Jakkuru Campus in Bengaluru, with Union Minister Pralhad Joshi as chief guest. The event will inaugurate a new NTH Bengaluru building and virtually launch several testing facilities across the country (Kolkata, Chennai, Jaipur, Varanasi) along with a new 'NTH Suvidha' mobile app for MSMEs and industry.
enrichment.context: The National Test House is India's oldest and premier testing and standardisation institution, established in 1912, functioning under the Department of Consumer Affairs. It provides testing, calibration, and certification services across sectors like textiles, chemicals, electronics, and construction materials, supporting quality control, consumer protection, and standards enforcement (linked to BIS and Legal Metrology frameworks). Expansion of testing infrastructure and digital access tools like mobile apps reflects the government's ongoing push for 'Ease of Doing Business' and quality infrastructure development for MSMEs, but this specific release is essentially an event announcement with routine infrastructure inaugurations rather than a new policy or landmark scheme.
